_note: Per-locale tool SEO seed for ClearLight Tools. fixed = authoritative building blocks (do not edit). cats[cat] = the localized long-tail category seoName for the category/all <title> and H1 (modifier + secondary intent, not the short nav label). tools[id] = { action (2-3 word core action for the title, natural case for this locale; CJK may omit), verb (function phrase for the meta description, in this locale's script), titleName (optional concise noun-form title keyword in ANY locale; the H1/nav keep the display name) }.
